newsA.title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
newsA.summary: NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face. Together, we will scale Hugging Face’s platform, strengthen its infrastructure and expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide. Hugging Face will remain an open platform.
